name: rlm
description: Recursive Language Model (RLM): delegate a text-processing task to a sub-agent that can recursively chunk its input (arxiv:2512.24601). Use this when you need to summarize, analyze, extract from, or transform a long piece of text that may exceed your context window — the sub-agent splits it into manageable parts and recurses as needed. Do NOT use this for reviewing your own past reasoning traces (use the reasoning tool instead), and do NOT use it for short texts you can process directly. Input: 'instruction' (required string — what to do with the text, e.g. 'summarize' or 'extract all error codes'), 'text' (required string — the full text to process), 'depth' (optional integer — current recursion depth, defaults to 0; normally omitted by the caller).
